business: Always Broke Ltd: a permanent holding company that buys owner-managed small and micro businesses and keeps their management and culture

benchmark.what: assumed share of approached owners who sign a deal within a year (no sourced benchmark found; this is a placeholder)

by_segment: Niche B2B product or service firm
Local retail, hospitality or consumer service

by_process: Owner decides after meeting the buyer
Bank and adviser vet the buyer first
Adviser or broker runs a process

why_not: A Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding is not who I hand my life's work and my twenty people to. I want the highest cash at closing from a buyer I can check, and 30% spread over three years from an unknown company is a risk I will not take.

The price sounds better than the 375,000 I would get on nexxt-change, but a new Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding is not someone I hand 22 people and my name to. A free first meeting is fine, but my adviser will pick it apart.
instead: Keep running the business, list it on nexxt-change, or talk to a known buyer or a competitor who pays more cash at closing.
Keep looking for a trade or management buyer or a broker sale via nexxt-change at around 375,000, or hand over to a known buyer with a bank-financed structure.
Keep running the business, list it anonymously on nexxt-change, and talk to buyers with known names, a German entity and a bank letter, or a family or employee succession.
Keep running the business and keep looking for a family or management buyout. If that fails, list it on nexxt-change or use a broker or a known German buyer.
Keep running the business, keep trying the family or management buyout, and perhaps list it on nexxt-change later if that fails.
Keep running the shop and look for a buyer through nexxt-change, my Chamber, my tax adviser or a local person who wants to take it over. Or I give it to a longtime employee over time.
Keep looking for a proper buyer through my adviser, the Handwerkskammer or nexxt-change, at around 375,000 euro, or a management buyer or trade buyer I can check.
Keep running the shop myself, and when I am ready look for a buyer through my tax adviser, the chamber of commerce or nexxt-change, someone I can meet who has a German bank behind them.
Keep going through nexxt-change or a broker, and talk to a known trade buyer or a management buyer at around EUR 375,000, even if it takes longer.
Hand over to family or a successor I know, or list the business on nexxt-change and deal with a buyer my bank and adviser can vet.
Keep running the business, talk to my adviser about a listing on nexxt-change, or look for a local buyer or a successor from within the company. Winding it down is the last resort.
Keep looking for a successor in the family or among staff, or list the business anonymously on nexxt-change and talk to a German buyer my adviser and bank already know.
Let my adviser run the sale through nexxt-change and take the highest cash offer from a buyer with proven funds, or hand over to a trade competitor or employee.
Keep looking for a family or internal successor, or list the business anonymously on nexxt-change and talk to a buyer who is established and has a German bank behind them.

Let my adviser run a proper process, use nexxt-change, and talk to buyers who can show proof of funds, such as a trade competitor or an MBI with a bank letter. Or keep running the business a few more years.
Keep running the shop, list it on nexxt-change, and have my adviser or a broker run a process with credible buyers who show proof of funds.
Keep running the business, look for a buyer through my adviser or nexxt-change, or find someone from the trade or a known German buyer with a bank letter and references.
Keep running the business, let my adviser run a proper sale process, list on nexxt-change, and talk to strategic buyers or a known Mittelstand holding with references and proof of funds.
Keep running the business and look for a successor or a known strategic or local buyer through my adviser, or list it anonymously on nexxt-change.
List the business on nexxt-change and wait for a buyer who pays more cash at closing. Failing that, keep working or wind down and sell the equipment.
